#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — headless GDScript syntax/parse validation.
# Loads every project .gd script with Godot's --check-only (no window, no
# host/client process, no project launch). Parse errors (bad indentation,
# undeclared identifiers, etc.) are caught BEFORE any networked run.
# Usage: validate-scripts.sh [log-path]   (default: stdout)  Exit 0 = all parse.
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"
OUT="${1:-/dev/stdout}"
if ! : >>"$OUT" 2>/dev/null; then OUT="/tmp/validate-scripts.$$.log"; fi
if [ "$OUT" = "/dev/stdout" ]; then OUT=/dev/stderr; fi

RC=0
{
echo "== GDScript parse validation ($GODOT --check-only)"
for f in "$DIR"/*.gd; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || { echo "no .gd scripts found"; exit 1; }
    echo "-- checking $(basename "$f")"
    if HOME=$GODOT_HOME "$GODOT" --headless --check-only --script "$f" 2>&1; then
        echo "   OK: $(basename "$f") parses"
    else
        echo "   FAIL: $(basename "$f") has parse errors (see above)"
        RC=1
    fi
done
if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "== VALIDATION PASS: all scripts parse"
else
    echo "== VALIDATION FAIL: parse errors present; aborting before launch"
fi
} >"$OUT" 2>&1
exit $RC

## Swift Arrival — Dogfood 4 networked delivery: playable-core revision.
## Host-authoritative, ENet (Godot high-level multiplayer), original placeholder
## geometry. All world content is built in code; no external assets.
##
## Playable core (this revision):
##   * View-relative first-person movement with real mouse look (yaw + pitch).
##     Strafe follows the camera basis, not a fixed truck axis.
##   * Real collision instead of clamps: the player is a CharacterBody3D; the
##     truck (AnimatableBody3D), ground, fence rails and crate are solid bodies.
##     Walls block from both sides; the player can leave the truck and walk the
##     bounded site on the ground.
##   * The crate rests on real geometry (ground, road, truck bed) and the truck
##     cannot drive through a crate resting on the road.
##   * Recoverable mistakes: E unload outside the destination zone is REJECTED
##     by the host (visible red feedback, crate stays carried); Q drops the
##     crate at your feet/facing — always pick-up-able, including behind the
##     truck at route start.
##   * The host validates client movement reports (speed, bounds, solid
##     geometry) and corrects offenders authoritatively.

const PORT := 24565
const TICK_HZ := 15.0
const TRUCK_MIN_Z := 0.0          # bounded route start
const TRUCK_MAX_Z := 40.0         # bounded route end
const TRUCK_SPEED := 3.0
const WALK_SPEED := 2.8
const GRAVITY := 9.8
const MOUSE_SENS := 0.0025
const PITCH_CLAMP := 1.25
# Destination zone (world space AABB): crate must come to rest inside it, on the ground.
const ZONE_MIN := Vector3(-2.0, 0.0, 34.0)
const ZONE_MAX := Vector3(2.0, 0.6, 37.5)
# Visible fence rails bound the walkable site (real collision, not clamps).
const FENCE_X := 10.0
const FENCE_Z_MIN := -8.0
const FENCE_Z_MAX := 55.0
const BOUND_X := FENCE_X - 0.36
const BOUND_Z_MIN := FENCE_Z_MIN + 0.36
const BOUND_Z_MAX := FENCE_Z_MAX - 0.36
# Player body metrics. peer_pos[id] = WORLD position of the capsule center.
# The placeholder truck's doorway/cab were sized for a point player; the cab was
# given real headroom (see _build_truck) so a capsule player fits through.
const PLAYER_RADIUS := 0.29
const PLAYER_HEIGHT := 1.62
const EYE_UP := 0.62              # standing eye height above capsule center
const SEAT_EYE_UP := 0.5          # seated eye height above capsule center
const SEAT_LOCAL := Vector3(0.6, 1.0, 2.6)       # capsule center while seated
const SEAT_EXIT_LOCAL := Vector3(0.0, 1.11, -3.25) # rear cargo threshold, clear of seat/divider
const HANDS_UP := 0.30
const HANDS_FWD := 0.5
const GRAB_REACH := 1.6
const SEAT_REACH := 2.2
const PLACE_FWD := 0.85           # unload/drop point this far ahead of the player
const CRATE_HALF := 0.35
const CRATE_START_LOCAL := Vector3(0.0, 0.65, -2.0)  # resting on the truck bed
# Host movement validation tolerances (checked per 1/TICK_HZ report).
const REPORT_MAX_HOP := 1.0       # ~2.8 m/s walk at 15 Hz, with margin
const REPORT_MAX_FALL := 0.75     # bounded falls only (largest step is 0.3 m)
const REPORT_STRIKES := 3

enum MissionState { IN_PROGRESS, DELIVERED }
enum JourneyStage { LOAD_AND_DRIVE, DRIVING, ARRIVED_SEATED, EXITED_AT_DESTINATION }

var mode := ""                    # "", "host", "client"
var probe := false                # scripted autopilot probe mode
var negative := false             # negative path: on-foot route-zero destination bypass
var mechanics := false            # mechanics assertions: view-relative basis + solid walls
var recovery := false             # recovery path: crate dropped behind truck at start
var shots_dir := ""
var my_peer_id := 0

# Host-authoritative replicated state
var truck_z := 0.0
var mission_state: int = MissionState.IN_PROGRESS
var deliveries := 0
var crate_holder := 0             # peer id, 0 = free
var crate_on_truck := true
var crate_local_pos := CRATE_START_LOCAL  # truck-local while resting on the truck
var crate_world_pos := Vector3.ZERO       # world while resting on the ground
var seat_occupant := 0            # peer id, 0 = free
var journey_stage: int = JourneyStage.LOAD_AND_DRIVE
var journey_driver := 0           # peer that drove loaded cargo to the route end
var drive_dir := 0                # input gathered from occupant (host reads)
var probe_phase := ""             # host probe coordination (harness info, not gameplay)

# Per-peer player state (host-validated; positions are world capsule centers)
var peer_pos := {}                # peer_id -> Vector3
var peer_yaw := {}                # peer_id -> float
var peer_seated := {}             # peer_id -> bool
var peer_strike := {}             # peer_id -> int consecutive invalid reports
var _pending_reports := {}        # peer_id -> Vector3 (validated in the physics step)
var peer_exit_grace_until := {}   # discard stale in-seat reports after authoritative exit teleport

var truck: AnimatableBody3D
var world_body: StaticBody3D
var crate_mesh: MeshInstance3D
var crate_collider: CollisionShape3D
var crate_base_color := Color(0.75, 0.55, 0.25)
var crate_flash_until_ms := 0
var crate_flash_color := Color.WHITE
var players := {}                 # peer_id -> CharacterBody3D
var my_body: CharacterBody3D
var my_yaw := 0.0
var my_pitch := 0.0
var banner_until_ms := 0
var hud_log_lines: Array[String] = []
var hud: CanvasLayer
var hud_role: Label
var hud_state: Label
var hud_controls: Label
var hud_banner: Label
var hud_log: Label
var hud_objective: Label
var hud_action: Label
var hud_crosshair: Label
var cam: Camera3D
var zone_mesh: MeshInstance3D
var truck_solids: Array[Dictionary] = []  # analytic {c,h} truck-local boxes

var _tick_accum := 0.0
var _finished := false
var _truck_block_logged := false
var _next_route_log := 10.0
var _local_drive_input := 0
var _probe_drive := false       # probe autopilot: hold driving input while seated
var _shot_timer := 0.0
var _shot_seq := 0
var _shot_dup := 0
var _p := {}                      # probe state

# Autopilot (probe modes): waypoint following through the real movement pipeline.
var _auto_wps: Array[Vector3] = []
var _auto_i := 0
var _auto_face := 999.0           # explicit facing once arrived
var _auto_crate := false          # seek a standing distance from the crate

# ---------------- lifecycle ----------------

func _ready() -> void:
	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if a == "--host":
			mode = "host"
		elif a == "--client":
			mode = "client"
		elif a == "--probe":
			probe = true
		elif a == "--negative":
			negative = true
		elif a == "--mechanics":
			mechanics = true
		elif a == "--recovery":
			recovery = true
		elif a.begins_with("--shots="):
			shots_dir = a.substr(8)
	_build_world()
	_setup_multiplayer_signals()
	if mode == "host":
		start_host()
	elif mode == "client":
		start_client()
	else:
		cam.global_position = Vector3(9, 5, truck_z - 9)
		cam.look_at(Vector3(0, 1, truck_z), Vector3.UP)
		_log("Idle. Launch with --host or --client (see run-demo.sh).")
		_log("Controls: WASD move (view-relative) · mouse look · E interact (grab / seat / unload in zone) · Q drop crate · Esc free mouse")

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _finished:
		return
	_sim_local_player(delta)
	if multiplayer.is_server() and multiplayer.multiplayer_peer:
		_host_validate_reports()
		_host_truck_physics(delta)
	truck.position.z = truck_z
	_tick_accum += delta
	if _tick_accum >= 1.0 / TICK_HZ:
		_tick_accum = 0.0
		_network_tick()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _finished:
		return
	# Fallback body spawn in case the first authoritative state arrived before
	# connected_to_server set our peer id.
	if mode == "client" and my_peer_id != 0 and my_body == null:
		my_body = _ensure_player(my_peer_id)
		my_body.global_position = _spawn_pos_for(my_peer_id)
		my_yaw = PI
		peer_pos[my_peer_id] = my_body.global_position
		peer_yaw[my_peer_id] = my_yaw
	_update_visuals()
	_update_hud()
	if probe:
		_probe_step()
	if shots_dir != "" and DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		_shot_timer += delta
		if _shot_timer >= 5.0 and _shot_seq < 120:
			_shot_timer = 0.0
			take_screenshot("seq_%03d" % _shot_seq)
			_shot_seq += 1


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if my_peer_id == 0:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.get_mouse_mode() == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		my_yaw = wrapf(my_yaw - event.relative.x * MOUSE_SENS, -PI, PI)
		my_pitch = clampf(my_pitch - event.relative.y * MOUSE_SENS, -PITCH_CLAMP, PITCH_CLAMP)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
			Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
				Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)
		elif not probe and event.physical_keycode == KEY_E:
			_interact()
		elif not probe and event.physical_keycode == KEY_Q:
			_interact_drop()

# ---------------- world construction (original placeholder geometry) ----------------

func _box(size: Vector3, color: Color, name_: String, parent: Node3D) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	mi.mesh = bm
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.name = name_
	parent.add_child(mi)
	return mi

func _solid(body: PhysicsBody3D, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3) -> void:
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var sh := BoxShape3D.new()
	sh.size = size
	cs.shape = sh
	cs.position = pos
	body.add_child(cs)

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if my_peer_id == 0:
		return
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.get_mouse_mode() == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED:
		my_yaw = wrapf(my_yaw - event.relative.x * MOUSE_SENS, -PI, PI)
		my_pitch = clampf(my_pitch - event.relative.y * MOUSE_SENS, -PITCH_CLAMP, PITCH_CLAMP)
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
			Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			if DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
				Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)
		elif not probe and event.physical_keycode == KEY_E:
			_interact()
		elif not probe and event.physical_keycode == KEY_Q:
			_interact_drop()

func _box(size: Vector3, color: Color, name_: String, parent: Node3D) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := BoxMesh.new()
	bm.size = size
	mi.mesh = bm
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.name = name_
	parent.add_child(mi)
	return mi

func _solid(body: PhysicsBody3D, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3) -> void:
	var cs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var sh := BoxShape3D.new()
	sh.size = size
	cs.shape = sh
	cs.position = pos
	body.add_child(cs)

func _build_truck() -> void:
	truck = AnimatableBody3D.new()
	truck.name = "Truck"

	var floor_size := Vector3(2.4, 0.3, 7.4)

	var dash_size := Vector3(2.4, 0.9, 0.3)

	dash.position = Vector3(0, 0.75, 3.55)
	_solid(truck, dash_size, Vector3(0, 0.75, 3.55))
	truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(0, 0.75, 3.55), "h": Vector3(1.2, 0.45, 0.15)})
	for sx in [-1.2, 1.2]:
		# Cab walls extended up (1.6 -> 2.05 tall) so the cab roof clears a
		# capsule player: the placeholder cab was sized for a point player.
		var cw := _box(Vector3(0.15, 2.05, 2.7), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "CabWall", truck)
		cw.position = Vector3(sx, 1.325, 2.35)
		_solid(truck, Vector3(0.15, 2.05, 2.7), Vector3(sx, 1.325, 2.35))
		truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(sx, 1.325, 2.35), "h": Vector3(0.075, 1.025, 1.35)})
	var roof := _box(Vector3(2.4, 0.15, 2.7), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "CabRoof", truck)
	roof.position = Vector3(0, 2.425, 2.35)
	_solid(truck, Vector3(2.4, 0.15, 2.7), Vector3(0, 2.425, 2.35))
	# Divider wall between cab and cargo with an open doorway (|x| < 0.6 at z = 1.0)
	for sx in [-0.95, 0.95]:
		# Divider walls extended to meet the raised top; doorway stays |x| < 0.6
		# but is now tall enough (clear 0.3..2.05) for a capsule player.
		var dw := _box(Vector3(0.7, 1.75, 0.15), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "DividerWall", truck)
		dw.position = Vector3(sx, 1.175, 1.0)
		_solid(truck, Vector3(0.7, 1.75, 0.15), Vector3(sx, 1.175, 1.0))
		truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(sx, 1.175, 1.0), "h": Vector3(0.35, 0.875, 0.075)})
	var dtop := _box(Vector3(2.4, 0.3, 0.15), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "DividerTop", truck)
	dtop.position = Vector3(0, 2.2, 1.0)
	_solid(truck, Vector3(2.4, 0.3, 0.15), Vector3(0, 2.2, 1.0))
	truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(0, 2.2, 1.0), "h": Vector3(1.2, 0.15, 0.075)})
	for sx in [-1.2, 1.2]:
		var sw := _box(Vector3(0.15, 2.0, 4.7), Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.7), "CargoWall", truck)
		sw.position = Vector3(sx, 1.3, -1.35)
		_solid(truck, Vector3(0.15, 2.0, 4.7), Vector3(sx, 1.3, -1.35))

	# Loading ramp at the open rear: real sloped collision, so the site can be
	# entered and left on foot (and a dropped crate can be recovered). The foot

	var s_y := 0.3     # (any lower exposes a lip of the floor face that wedges the capsule)
	var e_z := -4.9    # foot, buried below the road surface
	var e_y := s_y - slope * (s_z - e_z)
	var run2 := s_z - e_z
	var rise2 := s_y - e_y
	var ramp_len := sqrt(run2 * run2 + rise2 * rise2)
	var ramp := _box(Vector3(2.0, 0.1, ramp_len), Color(0.6, 0.42, 0.24), "LoadingRamp", truck)
	var mid := Vector3(0, (s_y + e_y) / 2.0, (s_z + e_z) / 2.0)

	seat_marker.position = Vector3(0.6, 0.6, 2.6)

	_label("RAMP", Vector3(0, 1.2, -4.1), truck)

func _ensure_player(id: int) -> CharacterBody3D:
	if players.has(id):
		return players[id]
	var b := CharacterBody3D.new()
	b.name = "Player_%d" % id
	b.collision_layer = 4
	# Players collide with the world (1) and the crate (2) but not each other:
	# body-blocking in a doorway or at the driver seat would be a soft-lock.
	b.collision_mask = 1 | 2

func _build_truck() -> void:
	truck = AnimatableBody3D.new()
	truck.name = "Truck"
	truck.sync_to_physics = true
	truck.collision_layer = 1
	truck.collision_mask = 0
	add_child(truck)
	truck.position = Vector3(0, 0, truck_z)

	var floor_size := Vector3(2.4, 0.3, 7.4)
	var floor_m := _box(floor_size, Color(0.5, 0.35, 0.2), "TruckFloor", truck)
	floor_m.position = Vector3(0, 0.15, 0)
	_solid(truck, floor_size, Vector3(0, 0.15, 0))
	for wz in [3.2, -3.0]:
		for wx in [-1.35, 1.35]:
			var w := _box(Vector3(0.3, 0.6, 0.6), Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), "Wheel", truck)
			w.position = Vector3(wx, 0.3, wz)
			_solid(truck, Vector3(0.3, 0.6, 0.6), Vector3(wx, 0.3, wz))
			truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(wx, 0.3, wz), "h": Vector3(0.15, 0.3, 0.3)})
	var dash_size := Vector3(2.4, 0.9, 0.3)
	var dash := _box(dash_size, Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "CabDash", truck)
	dash.position = Vector3(0, 0.75, 3.55)
	_solid(truck, dash_size, Vector3(0, 0.75, 3.55))
	truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(0, 0.75, 3.55), "h": Vector3(1.2, 0.45, 0.15)})
	for sx in [-1.2, 1.2]:
		# Cab walls extended up (1.6 -> 2.05 tall) so the cab roof clears a
		# capsule player: the placeholder cab was sized for a point player.
		var cw := _box(Vector3(0.15, 2.05, 2.7), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "CabWall", truck)
		cw.position = Vector3(sx, 1.325, 2.35)
		_solid(truck, Vector3(0.15, 2.05, 2.7), Vector3(sx, 1.325, 2.35))
		truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(sx, 1.325, 2.35), "h": Vector3(0.075, 1.025, 1.35)})
	var roof := _box(Vector3(2.4, 0.15, 2.7), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "CabRoof", truck)
	roof.position = Vector3(0, 2.425, 2.35)
	_solid(truck, Vector3(2.4, 0.15, 2.7), Vector3(0, 2.425, 2.35))
	# Divider wall between cab and cargo with an open doorway (|x| < 0.6 at z = 1.0)
	for sx in [-0.95, 0.95]:
		# Divider walls extended to meet the raised top; doorway stays |x| < 0.6
		# but is now tall enough (clear 0.3..2.05) for a capsule player.
		var dw := _box(Vector3(0.7, 1.75, 0.15), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "DividerWall", truck)
		dw.position = Vector3(sx, 1.175, 1.0)
		_solid(truck, Vector3(0.7, 1.75, 0.15), Vector3(sx, 1.175, 1.0))
		truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(sx, 1.175, 1.0), "h": Vector3(0.35, 0.875, 0.075)})
	var dtop := _box(Vector3(2.4, 0.3, 0.15), Color(0.85, 0.25, 0.15), "DividerTop", truck)
	dtop.position = Vector3(0, 2.2, 1.0)
	_solid(truck, Vector3(2.4, 0.3, 0.15), Vector3(0, 2.2, 1.0))
	truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(0, 2.2, 1.0), "h": Vector3(1.2, 0.15, 0.075)})
	for sx in [-1.2, 1.2]:
		var sw := _box(Vector3(0.15, 2.0, 4.7), Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.7), "CargoWall", truck)
		sw.position = Vector3(sx, 1.3, -1.35)
		_solid(truck, Vector3(0.15, 2.0, 4.7), Vector3(sx, 1.3, -1.35))
		truck_solids.append({"c": Vector3(sx, 1.3, -1.35), "h": Vector3(0.075, 1.0, 2.35)})
	var croof := _box(Vector3(2.4, 0.15, 4.7), Color(0.3, 0.45, 0.7), "CargoRoof", truck)
	croof.position = Vector3(0, 2.4, -1.35)
	_solid(truck, Vector3(2.4, 0.15, 4.7), Vector3(0, 2.4, -1.35))
	_label("CARGO", Vector3(1.0, 2.2, -1.0), truck)
	_label("CAB", Vector3(0.0, 2.2, 2.4), truck)

	# Loading ramp at the open rear: real sloped collision, so the site can be
	# entered and left on foot (and a dropped crate can be recovered). The foot
	# is buried below the road surface so a capsule only ever meets the slope
	# itself — an exposed leading edge behaves like a wall and blocks climbing.
	var slope := 0.35  # rise per unit run (~19.4°, walkable)
	var s_z := -3.7    # top of ramp EXACTLY at the bed floor edge, flush with its top
	var s_y := 0.3     # (any lower exposes a lip of the floor face that wedges the capsule)
	var e_z := -4.9    # foot, buried below the road surface
	var e_y := s_y - slope * (s_z - e_z)
	var run2 := s_z - e_z
	var rise2 := s_y - e_y
	var ramp_len := sqrt(run2 * run2 + rise2 * rise2)
	var ramp := _box(Vector3(2.0, 0.1, ramp_len), Color(0.6, 0.42, 0.24), "LoadingRamp", truck)
	var mid := Vector3(0, (s_y + e_y) / 2.0, (s_z + e_z) / 2.0)
	var n := Vector3(0, run2, rise2).normalized()
	ramp.position = mid - n * 0.05
	ramp.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-rad_to_deg(atan(slope)), 0, 0)
	# The collision shape must carry the mesh's FULL transform (rotation AND
	# position): _solid()'s position-only path produced an unrotated flat plate
	# that ended at the bed lip and blocked the ramp climb (owner evidence).
	var rcs := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var rsh := BoxShape3D.new()
	rsh.size = Vector3(2.0, 0.1, ramp_len)
	rcs.shape = rsh
	rcs.position = ramp.position
	rcs.rotation_degrees = ramp.rotation_degrees
	truck.add_child(rcs)
	# Analytic AABB for host validation: conservative bounds of the tilted slab.
	truck_solids.append({"c": ramp.position, "h": Vector3(1.0, 0.05 + 0.62 * slope / sqrt(1 + slope * slope), ramp_len / 2.0)})

	var seat_marker := Node3D.new()
	seat_marker.name = "DriverSeat"
	truck.add_child(seat_marker)
	seat_marker.position = Vector3(0.6, 0.6, 2.6)
	var seat_size := Vector3(0.7, 0.5, 0.7)
	var seat_box := _box(seat_size, Color(0.9, 0.75, 0.2), "Seat", truck)
	seat_box.position = seat_marker.position + Vector3(0, -0.15, 0)
	_solid(truck, seat_size, seat_box.position)
	_label("DRIVER", Vector3(0.6, 1.4, 2.6), truck)
	_label("RAMP", Vector3(0, 1.2, -4.1), truck)

	crate_mesh = _box(Vector3(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), crate_base_color, "Crate", self)
	_label("CRATE", Vector3(0, 0.05, 0), crate_mesh)
	var crate_body := StaticBody3D.new()
	crate_body.name = "CrateBody"
	crate_body.collision_layer = 2
	crate_body.collision_mask = 0
	crate_mesh.add_child(crate_body)
	crate_collider = CollisionShape3D.new()
	var csh := BoxShape3D.new()
	csh.size = Vector3(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	crate_collider.shape = csh
	crate_body.add_child(crate_collider)

func _ensure_player(id: int) -> CharacterBody3D:
	if players.has(id):
		return players[id]
	var b := CharacterBody3D.new()
	b.name = "Player_%d" % id
	b.collision_layer = 4
	# Players collide with the world (1) and the crate (2) but not each other:
	# body-blocking in a doorway or at the driver seat would be a soft-lock.
	b.collision_mask = 1 | 2

# Dogfood-4 verification harness — hardening record

Date: 2026-08-26 (UTC). Owner: swiftarrival-harness (Work a40ac633, attempt ae2f47ad).

## What changed

1. **`run-probe.sh` overall timeout hardening.** A watchdog (`sleep $PROBE_TIMEOUT`, default
   90 s) kills both host and client if either fails to write `PROBE RESULT: PASS` within the
   bound. On timeout or no-PASS exit, both logs are stamped
   `PROBE RESULT: FAIL (...)`, both log paths are printed to stderr, and the script exits
   nonzero. A clean passing run (both logs contain `PROBE RESULT: PASS`) still exits 0.
2. **`validate-scripts.sh` — headless pre-launch syntax validation.** Loads every project
   `*.gd` with `godot --headless --check-only --script` — no window, no host/client process,
   no project launch. Parse errors abort `run-probe.sh` (exit 2) *before* any spawn.
   `run-probe.sh` invokes it as its first step.
3. **Failure-run evidence snapshots** (below).

## Commands and observed output

Validation (current tree, `main.gd` 653 lines, post-repair):

    $ ./validate-scripts.sh
    == GDScript parse validation (/usr/local/bin/godot --headless --check-only)
    -- checking main.gd
       OK: main.gd parses
    == VALIDATION PASS: all scripts parse
    exit 0

Validator sensitivity — both historically observed error classes were reproduced against
synthetic scripts and both are caught with exit 1:

- `SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Unindent doesn't match the previous indentation level.`
  (the "indent at 624" class)
- `SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Identifier "hud_role" not declared in the current scope.`
  (the undeclared `hud_role`/`ms` class)

Timeout path — live run of hardened `run-probe.sh` (2026-08-26T12:21Z): client exited 1 at
~35 s without PASS; host stayed hung; watchdog killed both at 90 s:

    == TIMEOUT: no PASS within 90s; both processes killed.
    == FAIL: host log = /tmp/h.log ; client log = /tmp/c.log
    exit 1
    host log tail:  PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after 90s)
    client log tail: PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after 90s)

(The game still failing to complete a delivery is gameplay-side, owned by
swiftarrival-gameplay; pre-launch parse validation passes, so it is not a parse failure.)

## Preserved failure-run evidence

- `host-fail-20260826T122025Z.log`, `client-fail-20260826T122025Z.log` — snapshot of
  `/tmp/host.log`, `/tmp/client.log` as found at 12:20 UTC: a partial run (join, crate grab,
  driver seat reached) that never reached PASS.
- `host-fail-20260826T122228Z.log`, `client-fail-20260826T122228Z.log` — the 90 s timeout
  run produced above.
- `partial-network-run-host.log`, `partial-network-run-client.log` — pre-existing partial
  run evidence from earlier failure runs.

Known gap, stated plainly: the original parse-error console output from the three earlier
failure runs (indent error at `main.gd:624`; undeclared `hud_role`/`ms`) was overwritten in
`/tmp` by later partial runs before this Work started, so those exact bytes are not
recoverable. The error *classes* are recorded above and were re-verified against synthetic
reproducers; the surviving `/tmp` snapshots are preserved verbatim under their timestamps.

---

# Gameplay verification — final (swiftarrival-gameplay, closure)

## Acceptance runs (bounded harness only; raw launches excluded per policy)

| Run | When (UTC) | Command | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Independent (lead) | 2026-08-26 ~12:32Z | `./validate-scripts.sh && ./run-probe.sh evidence/independent-{host,client}.log` | exit 0, `PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS`, end-to-end delivery + clean shutdown |
| Fresh closure run | 2026-08-26T12:37:16Z | `./run-probe.sh evidence/live-probe-{host,client}.log` | exit 0 in 25 s, `PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS` (see review-target-live-probe.md) |

Both runs cover acceptance criteria 1–7 of docs/dogfood-4.md: host start, ENet
join with real peer ids, walk-through truck (cargo↔cab doorway), host-resolved
hand pickup/carry/release, driver-position bounded route drive, unload in
marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion visible on both
clients, clean shutdown. Criterion 8 (live review target + checkpoint) is the
run-demo.sh graphical session + review-shots + the closure commit.

## Failure history (kept, per policy)

1. Early runs (12:0x–12:2xZ): three same-class hung launches — probe lacked a
   working completion condition while main.gd was repeatedly corrupted by
   mis-anchored edits (parse errors: dead-code `_process` branch, undeclared
   `hud_role`/`ms`, lost `_tick_accum` accumulation → state sync never ticked).
   Two were terminated by owner rescue (see owner-attention.md), one class by
   the harness watchdog (timeout FAIL logs preserved:
   `host/client-fail-20260826T*.log`).
2. Post-grab stall (12:22–12:28Z): client never observed `crate_holder == me`
   — root cause the same lost `_tick_accum` (host state broadcast never ran).
3. Waypoint flip-flop (12:29Z): autopilot target condition toggled at z≈0.55;
   fixed with an explicit waypoint queue.
4. Shutdown race: client occasionally missed its PASS line when host quit
   first; fixed by logging PASS before the wait and on disconnect.
5. Negative-path mode (`--negative`): client PASS verified (host logs
   `MISSION: crate NOT in destination zone`), but the host-side auto-shutdown
   PASS line was never finished — **declared not acceptance evidence**; a
   cosmetic duplicate PASS line in host logs is a known limit.

No capability was claimed without a run: every table row in
capability-probes.md cites an observed command output.

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — focused repeatable verification probe.
# Launches one host and one joining client (Godot high-level multiplayer / ENet),
# both in scripted autopilot, headless. Exit code 0 = full delivery loop observed
# on BOTH processes: join, hand-interaction pickup, drive bounded route, unload in
# marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion, clean shutdown.
#
# Hardened:
#   1. Pre-launch headless GDScript parse validation (validate-scripts.sh).
#      Parse errors abort BEFORE any process is spawned.
#   2. Overall wall-time timeout (default 90s, override with PROBE_TIMEOUT).
#      If host or client fails to write 'PROBE RESULT: PASS' within the bound,
#      both processes are killed, logs are stamped FAIL, and the script exits
#      nonzero. A clean passing run still exits 0.
#
# Usage: run-probe.sh [--positive|--negative|--mechanics|--recovery] <host-log> <client-log> [shots-dir]
# Declared Work-gate aliases: --journey-positive, --journey-bypass,
# --mechanics-recovery (the last runs both mechanics and recovery sequentially).
#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    exit 2
fi

HOST_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --host"
CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --client"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && HOST_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && CLIENT_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --client --shots=$SHOTS"

echo "== host: $GODOT $HOST_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $HOST_ARGS >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "== client: $GODOT $CLIENT_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $CLIENT_ARGS >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!

# Overall watchdog: kills both processes if the bound elapses.
( sleep "$TIMEOUT" && kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null ) &
WATCHDOG=$!

TIMED_OUT=0
set +e
wait $HOST_PID; HOST_RC=$?
wait $CLIENT_PID; CLIENT_RC=$?
set -e
kill "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true

# Distinguish watchdog kill (128+15) from a genuine run; check PASS markers.
HOST_PASS=0; CLIENT_PASS=0
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$HOST_LOG" && HOST_PASS=1
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$CLIENT_LOG" && CLIENT_PASS=1

if [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 143 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 143 ]; then
    TIMED_OUT=1
fi
# Belt and braces: no PASS marker after $TIMEOUT of wall time means failure even
# if the processes happened to exit on their own first.
if [ "$HOST_PASS" -eq 0 ] || [ "$CLIENT_PASS" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$TIMED_OUT" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "== TIMEOUT: no PASS within ${TIMEOUT}s; both processes killed." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    else
        echo "== FAIL: process ended without PASS (host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC)." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    fi
    echo "== FAIL: host log = $HOST_LOG ; client log = $CLIENT_LOG" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "== host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC"
echo "== PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS"

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — focused repeatable verification probe.
# Launches one host and one joining client (Godot high-level multiplayer / ENet),
# both in scripted autopilot, headless. Exit code 0 = full delivery loop observed
# on BOTH processes: join, hand-interaction pickup, drive bounded route, unload in
# marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion, clean shutdown.
#
# Hardened:
#   1. Pre-launch headless GDScript parse validation (validate-scripts.sh).
#      Parse errors abort BEFORE any process is spawned.
#   2. Overall wall-time timeout (default 90s, override with PROBE_TIMEOUT).
#      If host or client fails to write 'PROBE RESULT: PASS' within the bound,
#      both processes are killed, logs are stamped FAIL, and the script exits
#      nonzero. A clean passing run still exits 0.
#
# Usage: run-probe.sh [--positive|--negative|--mechanics|--recovery] <host-log> <client-log> [shots-dir]
# Declared Work-gate aliases: --journey-positive, --journey-bypass,
# --mechanics-recovery (the last runs both mechanics and recovery sequentially).
#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    exit 2
fi

HOST_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --host"
CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --client"
if [ -n "$SHOTS" ]; then
    if [ "${HEADLESS_CAPTURE:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
        HOST_ARGS="--headless --rendering-method gl_compatibility --path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"
        CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --rendering-method gl_compatibility --path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 -- $MODE_ARGS --client --shots=$SHOTS"
    else
        HOST_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"
        CLIENT_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --client --shots=$SHOTS"
    fi
fi

echo "== host: $GODOT $HOST_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $HOST_ARGS >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "== client: $GODOT $CLIENT_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $CLIENT_ARGS >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!

# Overall watchdog: kills both processes if the bound elapses.
( sleep "$TIMEOUT" && kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null ) &
WATCHDOG=$!

TIMED_OUT=0
set +e
wait $HOST_PID; HOST_RC=$?
wait $CLIENT_PID; CLIENT_RC=$?
set -e
kill "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true

# Distinguish watchdog kill (128+15) from a genuine run; check PASS markers.
HOST_PASS=0; CLIENT_PASS=0
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$HOST_LOG" && HOST_PASS=1
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$CLIENT_LOG" && CLIENT_PASS=1

if [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 143 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 143 ]; then
    TIMED_OUT=1
fi
# Belt and braces: no PASS marker after $TIMEOUT of wall time means failure even
# if the processes happened to exit on their own first.
if [ "$HOST_PASS" -eq 0 ] || [ "$CLIENT_PASS" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$TIMED_OUT" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "== TIMEOUT: no PASS within ${TIMEOUT}s; both processes killed." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    else
        echo "== FAIL: process ended without PASS (host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC)." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    fi
    echo "== FAIL: host log = $HOST_LOG ; client log = $CLIENT_LOG" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "== host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC"
echo "== PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS"

#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    exit 2
fi

HOST_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --host"
CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --client"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && HOST_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && CLIENT_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --client --shots=$SHOTS"

echo "== host: $GODOT $HOST_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $HOST_ARGS >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "== client: $GODOT $CLIENT_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $CLIENT_ARGS >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!

# Overall watchdog: kills both processes if the bound elapses.
( sleep "$TIMEOUT" && kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null ) &
WATCHDOG=$!

TIMED_OUT=0
set +e
wait $HOST_PID; HOST_RC=$?
wait $CLIENT_PID; CLIENT_RC=$?
set -e
kill "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true

# Distinguish watchdog kill (128+15) from a genuine run; check PASS markers.
HOST_PASS=0; CLIENT_PASS=0
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$HOST_LOG" && HOST_PASS=1
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$CLIENT_LOG" && CLIENT_PASS=1

if [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 143 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 143 ]; then
    TIMED_OUT=1
fi
# Belt and braces: no PASS marker after $TIMEOUT of wall time means failure even
# if the processes happened to exit on their own first.
if [ "$HOST_PASS" -eq 0 ] || [ "$CLIENT_PASS" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$TIMED_OUT" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "== TIMEOUT: no PASS within ${TIMEOUT}s; both processes killed." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    else
        echo "== FAIL: process ended without PASS (host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC)." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    fi
    echo "== FAIL: host log = $HOST_LOG ; client log = $CLIENT_LOG" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "== host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC"
echo "== PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS"

#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — focused repeatable verification probe.
# Launches one host and one joining client (Godot high-level multiplayer / ENet),
# both in scripted autopilot, headless. Exit code 0 = full delivery loop observed
# on BOTH processes: join, hand-interaction pickup, drive bounded route, unload in
# marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion, clean shutdown.
#
# Hardened:
#   1. Pre-launch headless GDScript parse validation (validate-scripts.sh).
#      Parse errors abort BEFORE any process is spawned.
#   2. Overall wall-time timeout (default 90s, override with PROBE_TIMEOUT).
#      If host or client fails to write 'PROBE RESULT: PASS' within the bound,
#      both processes are killed, logs are stamped FAIL, and the script exits
#      nonzero. A clean passing run still exits 0.
#
# Usage: run-probe.sh [--positive|--negative|--mechanics|--recovery] <host-log> <client-log> [shots-dir]
# Declared Work-gate aliases: --journey-positive, --journey-bypass,
# --mechanics-recovery (the last runs both mechanics and recovery sequentially).
#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
…
fi

details.oldText:
#!/bin/sh
# Swift Arrival Dogfood 4 — focused repeatable verification probe.
# Launches one host and one joining client (Godot high-level multiplayer / ENet),
# both in scripted autopilot, headless. Exit code 0 = full delivery loop observed
# on BOTH processes: join, hand-interaction pickup, drive bounded route, unload in
# marked destination zone, host-authoritative completion, clean shutdown.
#
# Hardened:
#   1. Pre-launch headless GDScript parse validation (validate-scripts.sh).
#      Parse errors abort BEFORE any process is spawned.
#   2. Overall wall-time timeout (default 90s, override with PROBE_TIMEOUT).
#      If host or client fails to write 'PROBE RESULT: PASS' within the bound,
#      both processes are killed, logs are stamped FAIL, and the script exits
#      nonzero. A clean passing run still exits 0.
#
# Usage: run-probe.sh [--positive|--negative|--mechanics|--recovery] <host-log> <client-log> [shots-dir]
# Declared Work-gate aliases: --journey-positive, --journey-bypass,
# --mechanics-recovery (the last runs both mechanics and recovery sequentially).
#   positive: full loaded-truck delivery loop end-to-end
#   bypass: on-foot carry to destination at route 0 is rejected; no delivery
#   mechanics: view-relative movement basis + solid collision assertions
#   recovery: crate dropped behind the truck at route start is recovered
# (shots only render with a display)
set -eu
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
GODOT="${GODOT:-/usr/local/bin/godot}"
MODE_ARGS="--probe"
COMPOSITE=0
case "${1:-}" in
    --negative|--mechanics|--recovery)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe $1"
        shift
        ;;
    --positive|--journey-positive)
        shift
        ;;
    --journey-bypass)
        MODE_ARGS="--probe --negative"
        shift
        ;;
    --mechanics-recovery)
        COMPOSITE=1
        shift
        ;;
    --*)
        echo "unknown probe mode: $1" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
HOST_LOG="${1:?host log path}"
CLIENT_LOG="${2:?client log path}"
SHOTS="${3:-}"
TIMEOUT="${PROBE_TIMEOUT:-90}"
export GODOT_HOME="${GODOT_HOME:-/tmp/godot-home}"
mkdir -p "$GODOT_HOME"

# One declared acceptance gate owns two independently closing probes. Run both
# rather than setting both game flags (mechanics dispatch intentionally takes
# priority in-game), then preserve their complete logs under the requested paths.
if [ "$COMPOSITE" -eq 1 ]; then
    MECH_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.mechanics"
    MECH_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.mechanics"
    REC_HOST="${HOST_LOG}.recovery"
    REC_CLIENT="${CLIENT_LOG}.recovery"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --mechanics "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT"
    sh "$DIR/run-probe.sh" --recovery "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    cat "$MECH_HOST" "$REC_HOST" >"$HOST_LOG"
    cat "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_CLIENT" >"$CLIENT_LOG"
    rm -f "$MECH_HOST" "$MECH_CLIENT" "$REC_HOST" "$REC_CLIENT"
    echo "== COMPOSITE VERIFIED: mechanics PASS + recovery PASS"
    exit 0
fi

# --- Step 1: headless pre-launch syntax validation (no processes spawned) -----
if ! "$DIR/validate-scripts.sh"; then
    echo "== ABORT: GDScript parse validation failed; not launching host/client." >&2
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
    echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (pre-launch parse validation)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    exit 2
fi

HOST_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --host"
CLIENT_ARGS="--headless --path $DIR -- $MODE_ARGS --client"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && HOST_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 0,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --host --shots=$SHOTS"
[ -n "$SHOTS" ] && CLIENT_ARGS="--path $DIR --resolution 1280x720 --position 1320,100 -- $MODE_ARGS --client --shots=$SHOTS"

echo "== host: $GODOT $HOST_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $HOST_ARGS >"$HOST_LOG" 2>&1 &
HOST_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "== client: $GODOT $CLIENT_ARGS"
HOME=$GODOT_HOME DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-} "$GODOT" $CLIENT_ARGS >"$CLIENT_LOG" 2>&1 &
CLIENT_PID=$!

# Overall watchdog: kills both processes if the bound elapses.
( sleep "$TIMEOUT" && kill "$HOST_PID" "$CLIENT_PID" 2>/dev/null ) &
WATCHDOG=$!

TIMED_OUT=0
set +e
wait $HOST_PID; HOST_RC=$?
wait $CLIENT_PID; CLIENT_RC=$?
set -e
kill "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$WATCHDOG" 2>/dev/null || true

# Distinguish watchdog kill (128+15) from a genuine run; check PASS markers.
HOST_PASS=0; CLIENT_PASS=0
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$HOST_LOG" && HOST_PASS=1
grep -q -- "PROBE RESULT: PASS" "$CLIENT_LOG" && CLIENT_PASS=1

if [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 137 ] || [ "$HOST_RC" -eq 143 ] || [ "$CLIENT_RC" -eq 143 ]; then
    TIMED_OUT=1
fi
# Belt and braces: no PASS marker after $TIMEOUT of wall time means failure even
# if the processes happened to exit on their own first.
if [ "$HOST_PASS" -eq 0 ] || [ "$CLIENT_PASS" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$TIMED_OUT" -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "== TIMEOUT: no PASS within ${TIMEOUT}s; both processes killed." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (timeout after ${TIMEOUT}s)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    else
        echo "== FAIL: process ended without PASS (host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC)." >&2
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$HOST_LOG"
        echo "PROBE RESULT: FAIL (host_exit=$HOST_RC client_exit=$CLIENT_RC, no PASS)" >>"$CLIENT_LOG"
    fi
    echo "== FAIL: host log = $HOST_LOG ; client log = $CLIENT_LOG" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "== host exit=$HOST_RC client exit=$CLIENT_RC"
echo "== PROBE VERIFIED: host PASS + client PASS"
